issue_context.title: Are conditionally set decorated properties deoptimized?
comments: Shape should still be the same. It'll just be an empty string if the condition is not met.

Nice findings, this is a long post and I will review it asap.
I confirm your results and I have a feeling somewhere some optimization on this got lost.
I have a quick prototype that could fix it, so I'm pretty positive about it.

Awesome! If there isn't an optimization in the V8 engine I'm aware of, it seems as though decorated request and reply values (not methods) should be attached after object instantiation (instead of on the object prototype) but before they're run through the hook system to keep the hidden class consistent throughout every hook and route handler. Its consistent with the way that hooks are advertised and should fit into existing codebases by abstracting this phenomenon behind the framework.
That's awesome. Good job on the quick turnaround, and I'm glad I could unintentionally point out a bug!
